# ruststream-rumqttc

> `ruststream-rumqttc` is the MQTT 5 broker crate for RustStream, a Rust framework for services that subscribe to message brokers and publish to them. Over the `rumqttc` client it subscribes a service to topics and topic filters, publishes with a declared quality of service and retain flag, and carries headers as MQTT 5 user properties, so non-Rust peers see plain MQTT messages.

A subscription is a descriptor: `MqttTopic` for one topic, `MqttFilter` for a topic filter with wildcards, each with its own quality of service and share group; a bare string in `#[subscriber("..")]` is a topic. A routes file imports `ruststream_rumqttc::prelude::*`, which offers `MqttPublish` as `Publish`; a body that changes the quality of service or the retain flag of one message takes a step from `MqttPublishSteps`. An MQTT broker keeps one retained message per topic and the unacknowledged messages of a persistent session, and the framework's runtime supplies the rest, such as delayed retries.

This site holds the entry pages. The crate's guide is its overview on docs.rs, and the framework itself is documented on the RustStream site.

## Site

- [Home](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-rumqttc/latest/): what the crate does, the dependency lines and a first service
- [Benchmarks](https://powersemmi.github.io/ruststream-rumqttc/latest/benchmarks/): what this crate and the framework's runtime cost over the raw `rumqttc` client, per quality of service, and how to re-measure it with `just bench`

## Guide

- [Overview](https://docs.rs/ruststream-rumqttc/latest/ruststream_rumqttc/index.html): the transport, its connection task and what MQTT keeps
- [Subscribing](https://docs.rs/ruststream-rumqttc/latest/ruststream_rumqttc/index.html#subscribing): the two descriptors, wildcards, share groups, several subscriptions on one connection, and batches
- [Acknowledgement](https://docs.rs/ruststream-rumqttc/latest/ruststream_rumqttc/index.html#acknowledgement): what each handler outcome means on a transport with no server-side retry
- [Publishing](https://docs.rs/ruststream-rumqttc/latest/ruststream_rumqttc/index.html#publishing): the publish policy, the quality of service and retain flag of one message, headers and replies
- [The prelude](https://docs.rs/ruststream-rumqttc/latest/ruststream_rumqttc/index.html#the-prelude): what a routes file and a handler file import
- [The generated document](https://docs.rs/ruststream-rumqttc/latest/ruststream_rumqttc/index.html#the-generated-document): the MQTT bindings the `asyncapi` feature reports
- [Testing](https://docs.rs/ruststream-rumqttc/latest/ruststream_rumqttc/index.html#testing): the in-process broker behind the `testing` feature, driven by `TestApp`
- [Operations](https://docs.rs/ruststream-rumqttc/latest/ruststream_rumqttc/index.html#operations): authentication, TLS, sessions, last wills, keep-alive and packet limits
